name: Tamsye Prime
description: Tamsye Prime was a planet located in the Tamsye Prime system in the Thanium sector in the Outer Rim Territories. During the Clone Wars, the planet produced shell munitions for the Galactic Republic. In 5 BBY, Saw Gerrera abandoned Jyn Erso on the planet whilst on a mission there.
